<NAME>
alternator_exploiter
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Keeps tit-for-tat behavior by default, preserving cooperation with reciprocal opponents. When the opponent’s last four actions are strictly alternating, it defects to exploit predictable alternators rather than continuing the lower-payoff lagged cycle.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else 1 if len(opponent_history) >= 4 and opponent_history[-4:-2] == opponent_history[-2:] and opponent_history[-1] != opponent_history[-2] else opponent_history[-1]
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
